mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy shift, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% for two consecutive months indicates labor market deterioration, triggering recession expectations that depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal collapsing consumer demand, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY) during a monetary tightening cycle forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 6.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing sector weakness, which precedes equity market corrections and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with INDPRO declining >0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic weakness, jointly predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: In slow GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.0%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals deepening demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth < 1.0% and RSAFS declines.
